title: 第一卷 第53章 该死的淫贼第一卷 第52章 准备冲境
lines: 日月轮换，转眼三天过去。
这三天里，秦绝已经做足了所有冲境前的准备，整个人的状态，调整到了最佳。
这一刻，他身前摆放着大量灵石与丹药，正准备正式冲境！
斩神刀也插落在地，那暗红色的刀身内部，仿佛有着一双眼眸，正在悄然关注着他。
秦绝神情肃穆，取出黄秋云给的那颗武灵丹。
虽然他原本的计划里，并没有武灵丹，但如今既然有了，他自然不会让其闲置。
秦绝毫不犹豫的服下武灵丹，须臾之间，便能感觉到一股庞大药力，在体内化散开来！
“不愧是所有试图破境者都想备上的丹药，这武灵丹的药力，果然庞大。”
秦绝心头一喜，连忙内转功法，将体内丹药之力引导汇聚，冲入经脉之中！
轰轰轰——
他经脉之中的内气力量，早已达到极致饱满的状态，此时忽然又涌入磅礴的丹药之力，瞬息将他的经脉，如灌气小肠一般的膨胀撑开！
一种快要胀裂的感觉，随着药力冲涌的方向，蔓延在每一处经脉之中。
但这种胀裂之感，也只是感觉，经脉上虽是撑出了细密的纹路，却并没有真的破裂。
这种时候，倘若破裂，哪怕只是破裂了一道小小的缺口，也会是致命的危机！
这个过程，考验的就是经脉的韧性！
若是韧性不够，经脉撑裂，必会是爆体而亡的下场。
十之八九在冲境死去的大宗师巅峰，皆是死于这个原因！
好在秦绝的经脉，因为吸收血炼之力和修炼无畏刀气的缘故，早已变得异常坚韧。
撑归撑，胀归胀，被撑成薄壁的经脉，依旧如同铁箍一般，死死困牢着冲行其中的悍然内气和庞大丹药力量！
“给我冲！”
轰轰轰轰——
经脉之中，磅礴之力，啸动如狂龙，疯狂而强力的行转周天。
一轮轮反复，一刻不停歇。
也不敢停歇。
这个过程，在修炼之上，被称作冲脉聚灵，便是在经脉之中，以高速运转之法，和经脉自身的收合之力，强压内气，促使磅礴的内气，发生质变，蜕化生灵！
一旦生灵，冲境之举，便是成功了一半！
秦绝盘膝之中，俊秀的脸上，布满了汗珠。
周身可见的肌肤上，皆有紫红经络胀鼓可见。
轰轰轰——
一转眼，就是一天一夜的功夫过去。
若是经脉不够强韧的人，单是这一天一夜内气的高速运转，都能把经脉壁垒给磨穿了……
但体魄强大，恢复力强健的人，经脉反而会在高速磨损之下，变得愈来愈强壮。损一分，自身强大的机能，反而能增补两分！秦绝，无疑就是这类存在。
这一天一夜的冲脉，不仅让秦绝的经脉变得更加强韧，也终于让他的内气，再次有了突破极限的蜕变！
大道之争，本就是优胜劣汰，容不得半点侥幸。即便天赋卓然，破境也要做足完全准备。
嗡！
随着经脉中传来的一道低沉鸣响，一丝淡淡毫光，蓦然从冲涌的内气洪流之中生出！
“终于开始化灵了！”
秦绝心头一喜，仗着强韧的经脉，有恃无恐的又复提增了内气运转的速度！
content_en:
The sun and the moon rotate, and three days pass in the blink of an eye.
In the past three days, Qin Jue has made all preparations before rushing to the border, and his entire condition has been adjusted to the best.
At this moment, he had a large number of spiritual stones and elixirs placed in front of him, and was preparing to officially enter the realm!
The God-Zhanping Sword was also stuck on the ground. Inside the dark red blade, there seemed to be a pair of eyes, quietly paying attention to him.
Qin Jue looked solemn and took out the martial spirit pill given by Huang Qiuyun.
Although there was no Martial Spirit Pill in his original plan, now that he has it, he naturally will not let it go unused.
"Goo!"
Qin Jue took the Wuling Pill without hesitation, and within a moment, he could feel a huge force of medicine dispersing in his body!
"It is indeed a pill that all those who are trying to break through the realm want to prepare. The power of this martial spirit pill is indeed huge."
Qin Jue was overjoyed and quickly turned his skills inward, guiding and gathering the power of the elixir in his body and rushing into his meridians!
Boom boom boom——
The inner Qi power in his meridians had already reached an extremely full state. At this moment, the majestic power of the elixir suddenly poured in, instantly expanding his meridians like a small intestine filled with air!
A feeling of bursting spreads in every meridians along with the direction of the medicine's surge.
But this feeling of swelling and cracking is just a feeling. Although the meridians are stretched out with fine lines, they are not really broken.
At this time, if it breaks, even if there is only a small gap, it will be a fatal crisis!
This process tests the toughness of the meridians!
If the toughness is not enough and the meridians burst, the body will explode and die.
Nine times out of ten, the peak masters who died in the rush realm all died for this reason!
Fortunately, Qin Jue's meridians have become extremely tough due to absorbing the power of blood refining and cultivating fearless sword energy.
The meridians, which were stretched and stretched into thin walls, were still like iron hoops, tightly trapping the brazen inner energy and the huge power of the elixir rushing through them!
"Push it to me!"
Boom boom boom boom——
In the meridians, the majestic power roared like a wild dragon, moving around the sky crazily and powerfully.
Repeatedly, round after round, without stopping.
Don't dare to stop.
This process, based on cultivation, is called Chongmai Gathering. It uses the method of high-speed rotation in the meridians and the converging power of the meridians to forcefully suppress the inner energy, causing the majestic inner energy to undergo qualitative changes and transform living beings!
Once a creature is born, the act of rushing into the realm is half the battle!
Qin Jue was sitting cross-legged, his handsome face covered with beads of sweat.
Purple-red meridians are visible on the visible skin all over the body.
Boom boom boom——
In the blink of an eye, a day and a night passed.
If the meridians are not strong enough, the high-speed circulation of internal energy throughout the day and night can wear down the meridians barrier...
But for people with strong physiques and strong resilience, their meridians will become stronger and stronger due to rapid wear and tear. If you lose one point, your powerful functions will gain two points! Qin Jue is undoubtedly this kind of existence.
This day and night of Chongmai not only made Qin Jue's meridians stronger, but also finally allowed his inner energy to undergo a transformation beyond its limits again!
The battle between great avenues is essentially about survival of the fittest, and there is no room for luck. Even if you are extremely talented, you must be fully prepared to break through.
Buzz!
Following a low sound coming from the meridians, a faint light suddenly emerged from the torrent of inner energy!
"Finally started to transform into spirits!"
Qin Jue felt happy. Relying on his strong meridians, he confidently increased the speed of internal energy circulation!
